exposure: Root Cause Analysis (RCA) - Plan, Do, Check, Act (PDCA) nursing method
cohort: Patients who underwent cesarean section at Traditional Chinese Medicine of Southwest Medical University from January 2023 to December 2023
finding: The RCA-PDCA nursing model significantly reduced the incidence of intraoperative hypotension and postoperative complications during cesarean delivery compared to the general nursing model, leading to higher patient satisfaction.
